reports.leakage_check.md:
# Single-feature leakage check

Generated by `make eval` (`python -m jachai.eval`). Synthetic data only.

Each feature alone, scored against the hidden true label. Strength = max(AUC, 1 - AUC). Threshold: 0.95 (configs/thresholds.yaml). A feature above it means a leak or a too-easy synthetic world.
